headlines.title: Special Report: Katie Zacharia out as White House press secretary after 5 days on job
headlines.description: Katie Zacharia is out as White House press secretary after just five days on the job following a widely panned first press briefing and the revelation that she represented herself as a lawyer but did not pass her bar exam. NBC News' Gabe Gutierrez, Yamiche Alcindor and Kristen Welker provide details and analysis.

headlines.title: Police identify 16-year-old suspect in deadly Oregon school shooting
headlines.description: Investigators identify 16-year-old John J. Griffin as the suspect in the Oregon elementary school shooting that killed three children and a teacher, with law enforcement officials saying the gun used in the attack was purchased by his mother around the time of his birthday in August. KGW reporter Harley Coldiron reports from the scene and NBC News’ Tom Winter breaks down the latest developments in the investigation.

headlines.title: Man who confronted Oregon elementary school gunman identified by brother
headlines.description: Kaylub Giamanco was driving home from lunch when he heard gunshots and saw a gunman entering the Oregon elementary school his two young daughters attend.

headlines.title: Trump looms as tensions flare in final Maine Senate debate
headlines.description: The marathon of debates in the Maine Senate race has ended, but there is still one unanswered question: Just how large will President Donald Trump loom in November?

headlines.title: Oil surges to $110 per barrel for the first time since May
headlines.description: Oil prices jumped sharply Friday to their highest levels in weeks, as investors assessed the impact of both the Iran and Ukraine-Russia wars on global energy.

headlines.title: Trump says Ukraine resuming strikes on Russian oil sites is a ‘disgrace’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump has labeled Ukraine’s resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries a “disgrace,” the latest salvo in his campaign to pressure the U.S. ally over rising gas prices that could cost Republicans in next month’s midterm elections.

headlines.title: Elon Musk shows off ‘flying’ Tesla Roadster after years of delays
headlines.description: Elon Musk showed off the new Tesla Roadster prototype Thursday that can briefly launch itself into the air using rocket-inspired thrusters.

headlines.title: Amber Guyger, ex-police officer convicted of murder, is released on parole
headlines.description: Guyger served seven years of a 10-year sentence in the 2018 killing of Botham Jean, who lived in the same apartment complex.

headlines.title: Trump pardons two vehicle repair shop owners during Alaska rally
headlines.description: During his rally in Alaska, President Trump pardoned Zachary Czuback and Patrick Fleming, co-owners of a vehicle repair shop in Anchorage. Both pleaded guilty in 2022 to violating the Clean Air Act by tampering with federally mandated and monitored devices that tracked vehicles’ diesel emissions.

headlines.title: Malibu wildfire rages, triggering evacuations in Southern California
headlines.description: A blaze in Malibu known as the Bryson Fire has triggered evacuations in the famed Southern California beach community, and the weather will provide little relief over the weekend.

headlines.title: Billy Joel says he doesn’t know if he can perform on stage again due to brain disorder
headlines.description: The Piano Man still wants to play, but it’s not clear when or if he’ll be able to sing again for, as the song goes, “the regular crowd.”

headlines.title: Katie Zacharia is out as White House press secretary after just 5 days on the job
headlines.description: Katie Zacharia is out as White House press secretary after just five days on the job, sources said, following a widely panned first press briefing and the revelation that she represented herself as a lawyer but did not pass her bar exam. Earlier Friday, President Donald Trump said he would let Zacharia decide whether to remain as his press secretary after he suggested she was treated harshly by the media during her first week on the job.
